cells.announcement: January 29, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement - Customers on Task Factory version 2021.2 should begin transitioning to the latest version of Task Factory.
cells.eoe: January 29, 2025: End-of-Engineering (EoE) - Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for Task Factory version 2021.2 will no longer be actively supported by SolarWinds.
cells.eol: April 30, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) - SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for Task Factory version 2021.2.
